Catalogued Work :: Supreme Radio — 2023, Graphic Identity

For the identity of Supreme Radio P—S made the translation of “sound” into a graphic system. I created a signal, not a logo. It’s meant to feel like a transmission from somewhere familiar, but different. With homages to legacy brands and modern micrographics, the brand feels timeless but timely.
